cells.value: Dataset S1: Taxonomic assignment of 16S rRNA gene of most abundant (relative abundance provided by CLC software) microbes inside the different reactor configurations. The assignment was determined by BLASTN search against 16S rRNA (Bacteria and Archaea) database and by CLC software. Manual phylogenetic assignment was performed using BLASTN results refined with taxonomy identity thresholds defined by Yarza et al., 2014.
Yarza, P., Yilmaz, P., Pruesse, E., Glöckner, F.O., Ludwig, W., Schleifer, K.H., Whitman, W.B., Euzéby, J., Amann, R. and Rosselló-Móra, R., 2014.
Uniting the classification of cultured and uncultured bacteria and archaea using 16S rRNA gene sequences. Nature Reviews Microbiology, 12(9), pp.635-645.
